import os, sys, json, random, tempfile, subprocess, ctypes, shutil
rnd=random.Random(20260809)
axes=["signature","scope","revocation","expiry","basis","selection","closure","intent"]
N=12000

def make_case(k):
    vals={a:True for a in axes}
    if rnd.random()>.45:
        for a in rnd.sample(axes, rnd.randint(1,3)):
            vals[a]=False
    return vals

cases=[make_case(k) for k in range(N)]
ref=[all(c.values()) for c in cases]

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    cpath=os.path.join(td,"checker.c"); so=os.path.join(td,"libchecker.so")
    open(cpath,"w").write('''
#include <stdint.h>
int clay_check(uint8_t signature,uint8_t scope,uint8_t revocation,uint8_t expiry,uint8_t basis,uint8_t selection,uint8_t closure,uint8_t intent){
  return signature && scope && revocation && expiry && basis && selection && closure && intent;
}
''')
    gcc=shutil.which("gcc") or shutil.which("clang")
    if not gcc:
        print(json.dumps({"status":"NO_C_COMPILER"})); raise SystemExit
    cp=subprocess.run([gcc,"-shared","-fPIC","-O2",cpath,"-o",so],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if cp.returncode:
        print(json.dumps({"status":"C_COMPILE_FAIL","stderr":cp.stderr[:500]})); raise SystemExit
    lib=ctypes.CDLL(so)
    f=lib.clay_check; f.argtypes=[ctypes.c_uint8]*8; f.restype=ctypes.c_int
    ffi=[bool(f(*[1 if c[a] else 0 for a in axes])) for c in cases]

    child_code='''import sys,json
axes=["signature","scope","revocation","expiry","basis","selection","closure","intent"]
for line in sys.stdin:
 c=json.loads(line); print("1" if all(bool(c[a]) for a in axes) else "0")
'''
    blob="".join(json.dumps(c,separators=(",",":"))+"\n" for c in cases)
    pp=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-c",child_code],input=blob,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
    ipc=[x=="1" for x in pp.stdout.splitlines()]

    mutant_false={}
    per=1000
    for drop in axes:
        expr=" && ".join(a for a in axes if a!=drop)
        src="#include <stdint.h>\nint clay_check(uint8_t signature,uint8_t scope,uint8_t revocation,uint8_t expiry,uint8_t basis,uint8_t selection,uint8_t closure,uint8_t intent){return "+expr+";}\n"
        mc=os.path.join(td,"m_"+drop+".c"); ms=os.path.join(td,"m_"+drop+".so")
        open(mc,"w").write(src)
        mcp=subprocess.run([gcc,"-shared","-fPIC","-O2",mc,"-o",ms],capture_output=True,text=True)
        if mcp.returncode: mutant_false[drop]="compile_fail"; continue
        mlib=ctypes.CDLL(ms)
        mf=mlib.clay_check; mf.argtypes=[ctypes.c_uint8]*8; mf.restype=ctypes.c_int
        fa=0
        for j in range(per):
            c={a:True for a in axes}; c[drop]=False
            fa += bool(mf(*[1 if c[a] else 0 for a in axes]))
        mutant_false[drop]=fa

    print(json.dumps({
      "experiment":"EXP-CC-LANE-B-CROSSBOUNDARY-002",
      "cases":N,
      "reference_allow":sum(ref),
      "reference_deny":N-sum(ref),
      "c_ffi_mismatches":sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(ref,ffi)),
      "json_ipc_child_mismatches":sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(ref,ipc)),
      "child_exit":pp.returncode,
      "c_compiler":gcc,
      "wasmtime_present":bool(shutil.which("wasmtime")),
      "rustc_present":bool(shutil.which("rustc")),
      "single_check_mutant_false_accepts":mutant_false,
      "per_mutant_targeted_cases":per,
      "claim_boundary":"cross-boundary semantics proxy; C FFI and JSON subprocess tested, not full WASI/FFI capability-object implementation"
    },sort_keys=True))
